 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u079/system/state/workspace/programs/task-99f6aab6.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Summarize each region between solid separator lines: mark regions with 2 defects."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    def spans(length, separators):
        out, start = [], 0
        for i in separators:
            if start < i:
                out.append((start, i))
            start = i + 1
        if start < length:
            out.append((start, length))
        return out

    row_spans = spans(h, sep_rows)
    col_spans = spans(w, sep_cols)
    # The non-separator background is the most common color in the grid.
    from collections import Counter
    sep_r, sep_c = set(sep_rows), set(sep_cols)
    colors = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in sep_r
                     for c in range(w) if c not in sep_c)
    background = colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] != background
                      for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) == 2
             else background
             for c0, c1 in col_spans]
            for r0, r1 in row_spans]
"
}
